capabilities: remap the Thai characters ซ and ฅ to [ and ] while typing
insert brackets instantly as you type, with no extra keystrokes
customize or add character pairs by editing the CHAR_MAP object in main.js
extras: There is no settings UI; changing the character mapping requires editing main.js directly and reloading the plugin. Installation via BRAT is documented for beta/sideload use.
motivation: The README explains that the point is not to hunt for another key but to type wiki-links and Markdown brackets without switching from Thai to English.
problem: On the Thai Kedmanee layout, typing [[wiki-links]] or Markdown brackets forces a switch between Thai and English keyboards.
summary: Keyboard remapper that converts the obsolete Thai characters ซ and ฅ into [ and ] as you type, so Thai typists can write brackets and wiki-links without switching layouts.
